atoms.text: Rocco and Bunny are spending time together. See what Bunny does to make Rocco so happy!

instruction.text: Read and follow along with Bunny and Rocco’s conversation.
instruction.sound: ssml: Read and follow along with Bunny and Rocco’s conversation. <break time='700ms'/>Bunny has a little surprise for Rocco.

atoms.text: Bunny has a little surprise for Rocco.

atoms.b: Look Rocco, I baked you some bread! It has sunflower seeds in it, your favourite!
atoms.sound: ssml: Look Rocco, I baked you some bread! It has sunflower seeds in it, your favourite!<break time='500ms'/>

atoms.b: Bunny, that’s so nice. Why did you bake me bread?
atoms.sound: ssml: Bunny, that’s so nice. Why did you bake me bread?<break time='500ms'/>

atoms.b: I was thinking about you and wanted to make you happy.
atoms.sound: ssml: I was thinking about you and wanted to make you happy.<break time='500ms'/>

atoms.b: Oh Bunny, it always makes me happy just to see you! Now, I am twice as happy.
atoms.sound: ssml: Oh Bunny, it always makes me happy just to see you! Now, I am twice as happy.<break time='500ms'/>

atoms.a: How does Rocco feel about Bunny baking him bread?

feedback.end: That’s right, Rocco is feeling joy. Bunny made Rocco feel very special by baking him bread. He feels happy that others care about him.

atoms.text: Like anger, joy is a feeling that everyone experiences differently. Joy affects your whole body!

instruction.text: Find different parts of Rocco to see how he and others can experience joy.

feedback.end: Hands, legs and other body parts can express joy. Many people use their whole body to express their emotions, as if they can’t keep all their feelings inside!
Rocco’s eyes are shut. Some people close their eyes when they feel intense emotions, others’ eyes shine, or maybe even cry.
Joy can also make your tummy feel light, almost like it has butterflies. Some people laugh and laugh until their tummies hurt when they feel joy.
When some people feel joy, their heart is so full of happiness they feel it could almost burst!

atoms.text: Most people experience joy, but everyone experiences it differently. No matter how you feel joy, it’s okay!

atoms.a: Choose the child who seems full of joy.
